items.title: AI Agent
items.description: Self-scaffolding agent platform — describe a task in plain language and it builds a purpose-built agent (role, tools, implementation) via the Claude API.

items.title: Auth Login
items.description: Multi-tenant shared auth server — registration, login, token refresh, email verification, and password reset, auto-provisioning a siteId per consuming project.

items.title: Markdown Viewer
items.description: Lightweight Markdown rendering utility with syntax-highlighted code blocks and GitHub-flavoured Markdown support.

items.title: FPG Receipts
items.description: Receipt generator built for the Fitzroy Public Gallery — line items, commission and GST calculation, and bank details, laid out live against a print-ready preview pane for one-click PDF export.

items.title: Smooth Software
items.description: Smooth Software builds websites, apps, and admin tools fast, at straight rates. You get clean code, clear communication, and a product you will use and love

items.title: Scribbler 2026
items.description: Collaborative writing platform for organising work into Collections and Articles, allows suggestions and appraisal notifications, messaging — and distraction-free rich-text editing.

items.title: AI Forms - PDF Builder
items.description: Drag-and-drop PDF editor with AI form generation — describe a form in plain text and an agentic LangGraph/LlamaIndex pipeline generates the fields, layout, with pre-filled values.

items.title: ZOME: Spatial Messenger (Mobile)
items.description: ZOME is a spatial platform and messenger where you can plant your messages anywhere in the world, at any location and even points in time.

items.title: ZOME: Spatial Messenger (VisionOS & XR)
items.description: ZOME is a spatial platform and messenger where you can plant your messages anywhere in the world, at any location and even points in time.

items.title: Spatial UI Components for VisionOS
items.description: A library of reusable spatial UI components for Apple Vision Pro using RealityKit, SwiftUI.

items.title: Chatty Prayers — AI Debates, and Counsel
items.description: Personality-driven AI platform with one-on-one chat, confidant reflection, and structured multi-participant debate — built with Blazor and a RAG pipeline over the Claude and Gemini APIs, with conversation and dialogue persistence powering multi-personality, multi-participant exchanges.

items.title: JobFit™ — AI Job Match Analyser
items.description: Multi-provider AI tool that scores CVs against job descriptions, generates ATS compliant resumes, surfaces skill gaps, and drafts cover letters — exposes MCP tools for direct use from Claude.

items.title: Panic Stations
items.description: Turn-based sci-fi roguelike RPG built with React Native and Expo — procedurally generated space stations, tap-to-move pathfinding, and fog-of-war exploration.

items.title: Search in Robotic Task Planning
items.description: Academic research into heuristic search and efficiency for algorithms applied to autonomous robotic task planning.

items.title: ChattyPrayers.Api
items.description: ASP.NET Core API powering streaming chat, multi-participant AI debate, SVG generation, and RAG-based conversation search via Ollama embeddings.

items.title: MarkdownForms.Api
items.description: A .NET API that renders and processes dynamic form schemas defined in Markdown — PDF export with AcroForm generation and AI-assisted field population.
